summary: Remediated all reported feedback batch-upload defects. Duplicate required workbook headers now reject the file, ISO-style purchase dates are checked against the exact calendar date instead of relying on JavaScript normalization, product_code/product_name are trimmed and bounded before valid rows can be persisted, and uploaded source filenames are sanitized and capped before storage. Updated regression source checks for these cases. Verification passed after remediation: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\feedback-request-batch-upload-source.test.mjs` with 22/22 passing. An initial TypeScript check failed on named regex capture groups; that was fixed and the final TypeScript check passed. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email delivery were not run per task constraints.
